units.source_text: 过了片刻，道子说：抄近路走吧。

en.t: After a little while, Michiko said, Let us take a shortcut.

units.source_text: 我们便拐进了窄小的天满宫的院子里。

en.t: So we turned into the small, narrow courtyard of the Tenmangu shrine.

units.source_text: 樱树对寒冷非常敏感，樱叶仿佛想起来似的飘落下来，

en.t: Cherry trees are very sensitive to the cold, and the cherry leaves drifted down as though they had suddenly remembered,

units.source_text: 带着秋天隐约可闻的声音掠过了潮湿的土地，旋即又被风儿遗弃，静静地枯死了。

en.t: brushing over the damp earth with the faintly audible sound of autumn, only to be abandoned again at once by the wind and quietly wither away.

units.source_text: 穿过寺院后面的田间小径，很快来到了宽阔的马路上。

en.t: After passing along the path through the fields behind the temple, we soon came out onto a broad road.

units.source_text: 朝仓迈着快步，道子落在后头。

en.t: Asakura walked quickly, and Michiko fell behind.

units.source_text: 我望着道子走路的样子，心想：

en.t: Watching the way Michiko walked, I thought to myself:

units.source_text: 女人的美，只有在阳光下行走才真正变成赤裸的啊。

en.t: A woman's beauty truly becomes naked only when she walks in the sunlight.

units.source_text: 这位姑娘没有丝毫体臭，脸色苍白得好像生过一场大病。

en.t: This girl had not the slightest body odor, and her face was so pale that she looked as if she had been seriously ill.

units.source_text: 她仿佛沉浸在快活的底层，始终凝视着自己内心深处的孤独。

en.t: She seemed immersed in the depths beneath her cheerfulness, always gazing at the loneliness deep within her own heart.

units.source_text: 对于不习惯同女性一起走路的我来说，对方身高不同，弄得我很不自在。

en.t: For me, unused to walking with women, the difference in her height made me feel very awkward.

units.source_text: 道子脚蹬高齿木屐，踏在铺满砂砾的土地上，显出很难迈步的样子。

en.t: Michiko wore high-toothed wooden clogs, and as she stepped over the gravel-covered ground, she looked as though walking was difficult.
